annotation.summary_en: Israel's National AI Program (2021–2026, ~NIS 1bn), April 2025 snapshot. Reviews the global AI landscape and regulation, then sets five objectives: research infrastructure and talent, high-tech adoption via regulatory sandboxes, safe AI in the public sector, geo-technological positioning, and ministry-level preparation. It favors innovation-friendly, internationally compatible regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five objectives: AI infrastructure and research, high-tech adoption, public sector AI, global standing, ministry preparedness
Regulatory sandboxes in highly regulated fields to support innovation
Cross-government regulatory knowledge center, regulators forum, and expert advisory group
AI ethics and regulation policy principles paper planned for 2025
Disciplinary data assets built in compliance with privacy law and ethics standards
